findings.evidence: "Rule: `cd` into the first target and pass every other target with `--include-directories`." This has no branch for source-file targets: reviewing /work/app/src/auth.ts would attempt to change into a file, failing before Gemini launches.
findings.fix: Distinguish file targets from directory targets before constructing the command. For a source file, change into its repository root or containing directory and name the file in the prompt; pass only directories through `--include-directories`. Retain the stdin route for external standalone files, and perform the secret scan against the resulting workspace.
